sourceNote: WASM hash is the exact executable identity. Concurrent uncommitted E1003 test-literal and model-evidence changes do not affect these seven runtime profiles.
byteSource: Catalog default sources and hashes were unchanged. Already downloaded official bytes were supplied by an investigator-local URL map; the platform loader checked the pinned ZIP and entry hashes. This does not test browser CORS or fresh remote availability.

retention.rawReceipts: Not committed; original file SHA256 values are retained below.
retention.serial: Raw logs are not committed because they contain device identifiers. Exact hashes and selected identifier-free markers remain.
retention.frames: Original RGBA SHA256, dimensions and statistics retained for every capture. Selected PNG files are lossless encodings with decoded-RGBA equality asserted.
omittedFrames: TRMNL S3 provisioning screen contains a generated device SSID/QR code; publish its pixel hash/statistics only.
C3 has an entirely white framebuffer; its hash/statistics and watchdog failure are retained.

scope: ROM boot and the individually stated display/input checks only.
No DOM, WebGL, keyboard/3D hit-testing, browser CORS, networking or physical hardware acceptance is implied.
Inputs marked queued are transport acknowledgements, not proof of guest consumption. Visible changes or exact guest output are required for a passed interaction.
These concurrent runs are not a performance benchmark.
Catalog status remains partial/trial; full simulationVerified and hardwareValidated remain false.
